question: Assume today is 2026-08-29. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of people who moved between municipalities within Japan in August 2026 (Japanese and foreign residents combined), as first reported in the Statistics Bureau of Japan's monthly Report on Internal Migration in Japan Derived from the Basic Resident Registration.

target.caveats: The August 2026 report is published after the 2026-08-29 cutoff, so the target period is completed but the official figure is not yet available; all estimates must be built from prior months/years and current signals. p58.role: October 2025 monthly total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

methods.rationale: Anchors on the only observed monthly total (October 2025, p58) and scales it to August 2026 via a seasonal ratio (a1) and an annual trend factor (a2). Shared dependency: both a1 and a2 are assumptions, so the interval is wide; the main failure mode is that August seasonality differs materially from October.

p17.role: 2025 annual total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

a3.role: August share of annual mover total

methods.rationale: Uses the 2025 annual total (p17) times an August seasonal share (a3) times the annual trend factor (a2). Independent of the October monthly anchor; relies on the annual level and a seasonal share assumption. Failure mode: August share assumption error.

p17.role: 2025 annual total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

a3.role: August share of annual mover total

methods.rationale: Decomposition cross-check: the foreign component of August movers, computed as the annual total times August share times trend times the foreign share (a4). Declared as a part method (foreign channel only) so it is not averaged with full estimates; it serves as a consistency check on the foreign share assumption.

assumptions.name: August-to-October monthly mover ratio
assumptions.rationale: August and October are both moderate-migration months; August typically has a late-summer moving bump (Obon-adjacent moves) while October is a quieter month. The ratio is centered near 1 with a wide range reflecting the absence of direct August monthly data; the October 2025 monthly total (p58) is the only monthly anchor.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to scale the October 2025 monthly total to an August 2026 level, after adjusting for the annual trend.
assumptions.falsified_by: Direct August monthly totals showing a materially different seasonal ratio (e.g., August consistently 20%+ above or below October).

assumptions.name: 2026-to-2025 annual trend factor for movers
assumptions.rationale: Annual municipality-to-municipality movers declined ~0.3% in 2025 (p29) after ~1.1% in 2024 (p11); a near-flat to slightly declining trend is the best central estimate, with a range allowing for stabilization or a small rebound.
assumptions.applies_when: Applied to the October 2025 monthly total to bring it forward to 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: 2026 monthly data showing a sharp acceleration or reversal of the annual trend.

assumptions.name: August share of annual mover total
assumptions.rationale: Monthly mover totals average ~1/12 (8.3%) of the annual total; August is a moderate month, so its share is near the uniform 8.3% with modest seasonal variation. Used to convert the 2025 annual total (p17) into an August figure.
assumptions.applies_when: Used with the 2025 annual total to produce an August 2025 baseline, then trended to 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Direct August monthly totals showing a share outside this range.

assumptions.name: Foreign share of August movers
assumptions.rationale: October 2025 monthly data show foreign movers at 57,901 of 379,751 (~15.2%) (p63, p58); the foreign share has been rising, so August 2026 is likely at or slightly above this level. Used in the decomposition route.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to split the August total into Japanese and foreign components for the decomposition cross-check.
assumptions.falsified_by: 2026 monthly foreign mover counts showing a materially different share.

assessment.note: All are the same annual all-person municipality-to-municipality mover series from the Statistics Bureau; p1/p2/p3/p17/p22/p23/p26/p28/p32 and p73-p87 are duplicate vintages of the same table. They agree where they overlap (e.g. 2025 = 5,190,548; 2024 = 5,207,746). Use one vintage per year; the 2026-02 snapshot (p17, p32) is the most recent and should anchor the annual level.

Japanese-only and foreign-only annual mover totals; they sum to the all-person totals (e.g. 2024: 4,603,155 + 604,591 = 5,207,746; 2025: 4,528,254 + 662,294 = 5,190,548). Confirms the decomposition route and the rising foreign share (2022 ~10.1%, 2023 ~10.8%, 2024 ~11.6%, 2025 ~12.8%).

October 2025 monthly report: total 379,751 = Japanese 321,850 + foreign 57,901; inter-prefectural 168,057 + intra-prefectural 211,694 = 379,751. Internally consistent; p58/p88 and p59/p91 are duplicate copies of the same October figures. Provides the only observed monthly level and the October seasonal anchor.

July 2026 monthly report: total 390,799 = Japanese 335,854 + foreign 54,945; inter-prefectural 181,604 + intra-prefectural 209,195 = 390,799. This is the most recent same-year signal: total movers down 1.9% yoy, Japanese down 2.7%, foreign up 3.2%. It anchors the 2026 level and the Japanese/foreign split.

Population estimates: total ~122.68M (Aug 2026 provisional), Japanese ~118.99M and foreign ~3.82M (Mar 2026 final). Note p119, p121, p123, p124, p125, p127, p128 carry a spurious 1e9 multiplier in the value field (e.g. 122,811,000,000 for 1億2281万1千人); the quoted wording is the reliable figure. Use only for rate-based cross-checks, not as direct mover counts.
Annual migration rate ~4.1-4.2% and yoy changes (-1.1% 2024, -0.3% 2025) are consistent with the annual totals; p14 is a rate, not a count, so it can only enter a rate-based route.
Calendar facts for August 2026 (Obon 15 Aug, Mountain Day 11 Aug). They are contextual only; no quantitative bridge to mover counts is available, so they cannot enter a formula.

methods.rationale: Transfers the only observed monthly level (October 2025) to August 2026 via a seasonal ratio and a trend factor. Shared dependency: both a1 and a2 are assumptions, so the interval is dominated by assumption uncertainty; failure mode is a mis-set seasonal ratio.

a3.role: August share of annual mover total

methods.rationale: Annual level times August seasonal share times trend. Uses the most recent annual total (p17) and the same trend factor as m1; failure mode is the seasonal share, which is not directly observed for August.

p103.role: July 2026 monthly total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

methods.rationale: Carries the most recent same-year monthly total (July 2026) forward one month. This is the strongest same-year anchor; failure mode is month-to-month volatility, which a4's band covers.

Decomposes the July 2026 total into Japanese and foreign components (p108 + p112 = p103) and carries each forward separately, allowing different seasonal behaviour. Shared dependency with m3 on the July anchor; failure mode is that both ratios are assumptions.

assumptions.name: August-to-October monthly mover ratio
assumptions.rationale: August and October are both secondary-peak months in the Japanese mover calendar; without monthly August history the ratio is centred at 1 with a wide band reflecting seasonal spread.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to transfer the observed October 2025 monthly level to August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Monthly August totals showing August systematically far above or below October.

assumptions.name: 2026-to-2025 annual trend factor for movers
assumptions.rationale: Annual totals fell 0.3% in 2025 and July 2026 total movers were down 1.9% yoy (p103/p105); a modest further decline is the central case, with the range spanning flat to a slightly steeper fall.
assumptions.applies_when: Applied to a 2025-based level to project 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A 2026 monthly report showing total movers up year-on-year.

assumptions.name: August share of annual mover total
assumptions.rationale: August is a secondary-peak month; a 1/12 uniform share is 0.083, and the seasonal peak in late summer/autumn justifies a value slightly above uniform with a band covering the plausible seasonal range.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to convert an annual total into an August monthly figure.
assumptions.falsified_by: Monthly August totals implying a share outside 7.5-9.5% of the annual total.

assumptions.name: August-to-July monthly mover ratio
assumptions.rationale: July and August are adjacent summer months with similar mover volumes; the ratio is centred at 1 with a band reflecting month-to-month variation.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to carry the observed July 2026 level forward to August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Monthly data showing August consistently far from July.

assumptions.name: Japanese mover August-to-July ratio
assumptions.rationale: Same seasonal reasoning as a4 applied to the Japanese-only component.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to carry July 2026 Japanese movers to August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Japanese monthly data showing a strong August-July divergence.

assumptions.name: Foreign mover August-to-July ratio
assumptions.rationale: Same seasonal reasoning as a4 applied to the foreign-only component.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to carry July 2026 foreign movers to August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Foreign monthly data showing a strong August-July divergence.

methods.label: m1

p58.role: October 2025 monthly total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

methods.rationale: Transfers the only observed monthly level (October 2025) to August 2026 via a seasonal ratio and a trend factor. Shared dependency: both a1 and a2 are assumptions, so the interval is dominated by assumption uncertainty; failure mode is a mis-set seasonal ratio.

methods.label: m2

p17.role: 2025 annual total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

a3.role: August share of annual mover total

methods.rationale: Annual level times August seasonal share times trend. Uses the most recent annual total (p17) and the same trend factor as m1; failure mode is the seasonal share, which is not directly observed for August.

methods.label: m3

p103.role: July 2026 monthly total municipality-to-municipality movers, all persons, Japan

methods.rationale: Carries the most recent same-year monthly total (July 2026) forward one month. This is the strongest same-year anchor; failure mode is month-to-month volatility, which a4's band covers.

methods.label: m4
methods.rationale: Decomposes the July 2026 total into Japanese and foreign components (p108 + p112 = p103) and carries each forward separately, allowing different seasonal behaviour. Shared dependency with m3 on the July anchor; failure mode is that both ratios are assumptions.

kept.name: August-to-October monthly mover ratio
kept.rationale: August and October are both secondary-peak months in the Japanese mover calendar; without monthly August history the ratio is centred at 1 with a wide band reflecting seasonal spread.
kept.applies_when: Used to transfer the observed October 2025 monthly level to August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Monthly August totals showing August systematically far above or below October.

kept.name: 2026-to-2025 annual trend factor for movers
kept.rationale: Annual totals fell 0.3% in 2025 and July 2026 total movers were down 1.9% yoy (p103/p105); a modest further decline is the central case, with the range spanning flat to a slightly steeper fall.
kept.applies_when: Applied to a 2025-based level to project 2026.
kept.falsified_by: A 2026 monthly report showing total movers up year-on-year.

kept.name: August share of annual mover total
kept.rationale: August is a secondary-peak month; a 1/12 uniform share is 0.083, and the seasonal peak in late summer/autumn justifies a value slightly above uniform with a band covering the plausible seasonal range.
kept.applies_when: Used to convert an annual total into an August monthly figure.
kept.falsified_by: Monthly August totals implying a share outside 7.5-9.5% of the annual total.

kept.name: August-to-July monthly mover ratio
kept.rationale: July and August are adjacent summer months with similar mover volumes; the ratio is centred at 1 with a band reflecting month-to-month variation.
kept.applies_when: Used to carry the observed July 2026 level forward to August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Monthly data showing August consistently far from July.

kept.name: Japanese mover August-to-July ratio
kept.rationale: Same seasonal reasoning as a4 applied to the Japanese-only component.
kept.applies_when: Used to carry July 2026 Japanese movers to August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Japanese monthly data showing a strong August-July divergence.

kept.name: Foreign mover August-to-July ratio
kept.rationale: Same seasonal reasoning as a4 applied to the foreign-only component.
kept.applies_when: Used to carry July 2026 foreign movers to August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Foreign monthly data showing a strong August-July divergence.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
